promptPrefix: Documentary reportage photograph, editorial quality, photojournalism aesthetic —
promptSuffix: Render as a serious documentary photograph: available light, the energy of the real moment, not a staged portrait. The quality should feel like it belongs in a newspaper front page or a World Press Photo submission.
variantDirectives: Wide documentary frame, the figures small within the crowd and street:
Full-length frame in the thick of it, posture and gesture carry the moment:
Tight close-up, faces fill the frame:
The street and scene dominate the frame, the figures secondary:
Clothing, signs and banners take centre stage, the figures framed to show them:

translations.individual vs. crowd: the individual held inside the crowd
translations.sign vs. silence: the sign raised against a silence that refuses to end
translations.marching vs. standing still: marching forward or standing still as the act
translations.anger vs. hope: anger and hope occupying the same body
translations.arrested vs. free: the arrested and the free facing each other
translations.chant vs. quiet: the chant breaking through the enforced quiet
translations.seen vs. ignored: demanding to be seen by those who refuse to look
translations.together vs. alone in cause: together in the cause, alone in what it costs
translations.fear vs. conviction: fear and conviction arriving at the same moment
translations.front line vs. witness: standing at the front line or bearing witness from behind
translations.peaceful vs. tense: peaceful intention pressed against a tense moment
translations.symbol vs. person: the symbol carried by the full weight of the person
translations.media vs. moment: the media presence against the unmediated moment
translations.demand vs. plea: the demand that refuses to become a plea
translations.unity vs. division: unity as the only answer to division
translations.act vs. consequence: the act and the consequence arriving together
translations.present vs. history: standing in the present knowing it is becoming history
